title: お歳暮・お礼状の飾り
lead: お歳暮のお礼状や贈答の挨拶状に添える、和のモチーフ12点です。封筒・水引・椿・南天などを、礼状やおたよりの飾りに使えます。
subject_en: Japanese gift-giving and thank-you-letter motifs, each a separate object centred in its cell, calm traditional colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a blank cream envelope sealed with a small red mizuhiki knot
a rolled traditional Japanese letter scroll, blank, tied with a cord
a calligraphy brush resting on an inkstone
a red and white mizuhiki decorative knot
a blank noshi paper ornament with folded gold-and-red decoration
a branch of red camellia flowers with green leaves
a branch of nandina with red berries
a pine branch with needles and a small cone
a gift wrapped in a patterned furoshiki cloth
a gift box tied with a white and red cord
a tea cup with a small Japanese sweet on a plate
a small simple character figure in kimono bowing politely, plain face, no features
